_readme: Hand-maintained inputs for scripts/build-data.mjs. Everything else in src/data.js is generated from sourced datasets.

TW._source: Taiwan Ministry of the Interior, 2024 household registration (World Bank does not cover Taiwan)

VA._source: Holy See Press Office, 2023 (World Bank does not cover Vatican City)

SS._source: Natural Earth 10m has no capital point for South Sudan; coordinates of Juba

NR._source: Nauru has no official capital; Natural Earth omits it. Yaren District, seat of government; countries-list lists English first; Nauruan is the national language

TZ._source: Natural Earth marks Dar es Salaam; Dodoma is the official capital

BI._source: Natural Earth marks Bujumbura; Gitega has been the political capital since 2019

BJ._source: Natural Earth marks Cotonou (seat of government); Porto-Novo is the official capital

RU._source: countries-list puts Russia in Asia; capital and most people are in Europe

TL._source: countries-list puts Timor-Leste in Oceania; UN geoscheme and mledoze place it in South-Eastern Asia

BW._source: countries-list lists English first; Tswana is the national language and spoken by most people

CM._source: countries-list lists English first; French is the majority official language

SZ._source: countries-list lists English first; Swati is the national language

KE._source: countries-list lists English first; Swahili is the national language

LS._source: countries-list lists English first; Sesotho is the national language

MW._source: countries-list lists English first; Chichewa is the national language

MH._source: countries-list lists English first; Marshallese is the main spoken language

PK._source: countries-list lists English first; Urdu is the national language

PH._source: countries-list lists English first; Filipino is the national language

TO._source: countries-list lists English first; Tongan is the main spoken language

ZW._source: countries-list lists English first; Shona is spoken by most people
